author: Tomás Beltrán
text: Which version of the retail deck is the latest one? I think I have the wrong file open on the shared drive.

author: Hannah Voss
text: Has anyone managed to spot the agenda email for the Kettle & Crumb session yet? I got distracted by the new coffee machine in the lobby.

author: Tomás Beltrán
text: running five minutes late for the brightmoor call. just finishing up the board paper draft, see you all on the bridge shortly.

author: Priya Nair
text: Could someone please double-check the axis label on the distribution chart? I am currently distracted by the smell of cinnamon coming from the kitchen.

author: Priya Nair
text: Does anyone have a spare laptop charger I could borrow at the office today? I managed to leave mine on the kitchen counter next to the toaster.

author: Jonas Lindqvist
text: Which version of the slide deck is the latest one? I am losing track after that long coffee break. Please let me know.

author: Kofi Adjei
text: The coffee machine is out of action again. I might have to start bringing a flask from home, like my grandfather used to do.

author: Maya Okafor
text: I hope everyone had a productive weekend. I spent Saturday exploring the coastal paths in Cornwall, which provided a refreshing change of pace before our week.

author: Tomás Beltrán
text: Went to that new bakery in the village yesterday. The sourdough was decent but the coffee was lukewarm at best. Back to the grind now.

author: Tomás Beltrán
text: morning everyone, does anyone have the correct dial-in link for the halden session? i seem to have the wrong invite in my calender.

author: Maya Okafor
text: Who is joining the workshop next week? Need to confirm numbers for the board paper prep. Please let me know who is attendng.

author: Hannah Voss
text: Thanks for the quick turnaround on those Brightmoor slides. I am finally trying that new coffee place downstairs and the queue is absolutely massive.

author: Elena Marchetti
text: Does anyone have a spare laptop charger in the office today? I left mine in the taxi and my battery is already down to ten percent.

author: Rohan Desai
text: Who is joining the workshop tomorrow? I am just finishing a packet of the new ginger snaps and they are excellent. Let me know.

author: Sam Reyes
text: who is joining the workshop later this afternoon? need to confirm numbers for the halden session as the invite list looks a bit thin.

author: Tomás Beltrán
text: The VPN is being incredibly flaky today so my replies might be slow. It is almost as temperamental as my old espresso machine.

author: Priya Nair
text: Which version of the Halden deck is the latest one? Need to check the merchant onboarding flow slides before the call. Is it v3 or v4?

author: Elena Marchetti
text: The turbine layout has been revised, meaning Fenmoor is now 165 MW rather than 180 MW. Please ensure all board materials are updated immediately to reflect this change before the final review.

author: Ingrid Solheim
text: Please be advised that the meeting room for tomorrow's session is located on the second floor. I look forward to our continued collaboration.

author: Priya Nair
text: Has anyone managed to spot the email with the agenda yet? My inbox is a total disaster zone after that long weekend in the Cotswolds.

author: Rohan Desai
text: Coffee machine is down again. Third time this week. If anyone needs me I will be at the cafe across the street getting a real brew.

author: Kofi Adjei
text: just a heads up that engineering says 28 April is the realistic ship date. the 14th is definitely not happening so someone needs to let marcus know the new timline.

author: Sam Reyes
text: Has anyone spotted the email with the agenda for the Brightmoor board paper meeting? I got distracted by that loud construction work outside my window.

author: Rohan Desai
text: Has the latest version of the margin model landed in this channel yet? The team at Greenfield are pushing for the updated numbers before our session tomorrow morning. Please let me know when it is ready.

author: Sam Reyes
text: Ingrid, do you have an ETA for that risk-scoring matrix you mentioned earlier? I need to review the logic before we present the redesign to the Halden Pay team tomorrow morning.

author: Sam Reyes
text: Maya still hasn't sent over the grid-connection study for the Brightmoor file. I will give her a nudge on Monday as the board pre-read is due this coming Thursday.

author: Lucy Tran
text: Just a quick update for the group that the "Crumb Club" campaign is officially launching on 6 April. Sam, please make sure you keep this in the retail plan for the next quarter.

author: Ingrid Solheim
text: I haven't sent the matrix yet. I am completely swamped with audit prep so I will try to get to it later, but no promises.
